fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestRunSpawn passes with a new case: a --no-wait spawn returns while its child still runs, with the session set, no outcome or detail, exit code 0, a spawn entry marked no-wait and no spawn-ended entry journaled, and the child's pane left open; the existing waiting cases still pass unchanged (their spawn entries carry no no-wait mark); (failure case) a --no-wait spawn whose child cannot be started returns the start error and journals no spawn entry. go test -trimpath ./internal/run -run 'TestSpawn|TestFold' shows the no-wait mark folded onto State.Spawns. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-spawn|describe-golden)' passes, describe-golden regenerated with -update.
fields.must_not: Change the default (waiting) behaviour, output or exit codes of rhiza run spawn; journal a spawn-ended entry or close the child's pane from a --no-wait spawn; send any message
fields.statement: rhiza run spawn --no-wait returns once the child session is started and its spawn entry is journaled, the entry marked no-wait (a new journal field, folded onto run.Spawn), its response carrying the child's session and brief and no outcome, exit 0; the hold wait before the start is unchanged, and without --no-wait spawn waits and prints the outcome exactly as today.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/run -run 'TestSpawnWake|TestSpawnResume' passes: a no-wait child that said done and one that exited 1 each produce exactly one wake call to the parent with the child's role, leaf, outcome and detail, also when the poll repeats and after a driver restart; (failure case) a waiting (not no-wait) child's end recorded by the engine wakes no one, and a wake that returns an error is logged, leaves the spawn-ended entry in place and is not retried. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestRunSpawnWake|TestRunSpawn' passes: the stepRunner's wake closes a said-done child's pane and writes a message file under the parent's .rhiza/local/messages folder naming the child, role, leaf and outcome, and leaves the pane of a child that exited alone.
fields.must_not: Wake the conductor for a child's question or other block (askChildren and the arbiter keep those); message a parent twice for one child; let a wake failure fail the step or the run; block the engine's poll for longer than a short message timeout (session.message queues the pointer while the parent works)
fields.statement: When the run engine's reconcileSpawns journals the end of a no-wait spawned child (AppendSpawnEnded added it, so once per child), it closes the child's Rex pane if it said done, as a waiting spawn does, and sends the child's parent session a rhiza session message naming the child session, its role, leaf, outcome and detail and pointing at rhiza run status for the rest; the engine reaches both through an optional Runner interface (the engine runs no program), implemented by the api stepRunner over closeSessionPane and session.message.

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/guide/... passes with a test asserting conduct-roles.md documents --no-wait and the wake-up message and conduct.md tells the conductor to end its turn after a --no-wait spawn; (failure case) the test fails on the current text, which says only that the spawn waits for the child. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestDocsPrimitives|TestScripts/guide-install' passes.
fields.must_not: Change any role other than the conductor's instructions; drop the rule that the conductor never sleeps or polls; tell a conductor to poll run status for its children
fields.statement: The conduct guides (conduct, conduct-roles) and the run spawn docs tell a conductor to spawn children with --no-wait, start independent children together, end its turn, and act on the wake-up session message each child's end sends (reading rhiza run status --json for the outcomes), and still describe the default waiting spawn for other callers.
